objective: Preserve actual short responses and add optional level/slope resets to continuous-ramp CPOP, without changing or downweighting observations.

candidate.jump_proposals: Top6 native boundaries by maximum standardized local level difference at widths1/2/4, plus actual command changes. No point removed; candidates not required transitions.
candidate.inner_model: Original native continuous CPOP in each block; all blocks use global full-task beta=2log(n), same original scalar sd, native x/grid,minseglen0,exact pruning. One-point block is its observed constant; two-point block is its line, no unidentifiable timing claims.
candidate.outer_model: Unpruned partition DP over fixed proposal nodes; free level and slope reset across selected boundaries, optional zero-jump original CPOP included.
candidate.ratio2_control: Original CPOP can connect any free jump by a steep link with at most2 extra slope changes. gamma>=2beta is dominated or tied; ratio2 is a no-jump mathematical control, not a new effective candidate or a validation choice.
candidate.tie: For costs equal within1e-10 relative tolerance choose fewer jumps then lexicographically earlier partition.
candidate.guarantee_scope: Exact outer optimization only in fixed finite candidate dictionary, conditional on native block fits; not arbitrary jump locations or GRACE's general multivariate recursion, and does not preserve incoming slope across resets.

reuse_and_sources.cpop: Existing locked1.0.10 original scalar adapter and R runtime; do not upgrade/install. GPL package remains separate unchanged.
reuse_and_sources.labs: Existing author MIT core fixed0bb0524dec39336a2e0d032287ce092e2968145a, original M5R2/sSIC.
reuse_and_sources.GRACE: 2026-10-12v2 preprint supports optional transition types; no mature author implementation verified, do not call this exact replication.
reuse_and_sources.MOSUM: Technometrics2024 supports jumps/slopes at multiple scales; author Rcpp repo license not verified, no copying/installing. Short local-OLS proposal independently implemented; no asymptotic alpha5% claim.

shared_domain.reference: Explicit known simulated untreated power, not a prediction or command. Unknown-reference field performance not inferred.

simulation.generator: Unchanged prior independent ODE+real single-bin response/gap safeguards, new seeds/users. No jump-CPOP inverse generation.

selection: Among active ratios1/1.5 with100% validation availability choose smaller equal-condition mean of cumulative/longest duration MAE averaged, tie within1e-9 then larger ratio. Freeze before generating new test. Candidate may fail adoption gates; no test-based switching.
metrics: Identical prior audited production feature extractor and evaluator: cumulative/longest duration, onset/target/recovery with all missing states, false/missed threshold minutes, curve/peak, raw eta and runtime. Finite grid timing, not physical sub-bin actions. No event outcome filtering.

real_auxiliary.selection: From previous fixed144 KIT events, take first and last by edge_index within each recording/direction,72events/18recordings. Fixed before computation, no new real field holdout.
real_auxiliary.reference: Original100ms observation descriptors and same-method Gaussian->sameGaussian+spike change; no latent clean truth or net-reference.
real_auxiliary.units: Seconds and command-normalized phase current; no minute/kW interchange.

stop: One bounded structural version, validation and once frozen new test. No extra ratio search or dropping hard cases. No prediction, effects, other resources, reports, new libraries/GPU, deletion, upload or commit. Adopt only supported scope after gates and review; no silent global default change.
